content.json:
# Netcraft App — Operations

Latest App results from the Integration Gateway (`NetcraftAppResult_CL`). Use `NetcraftAppResult_Latest` so re-delivered updates collapse to one row per `ResultUuid`. Charts use `Risk.category`.

content.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| summarize Events = count() by RiskCategory
| order by Events desc
content.title: Results by risk

content.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by ChangeType
| order by Events desc
content.title: Deliveries by change_type

content.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by Platform
| order by Events desc
content.title: Latest results by platform

content.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ChangeType
| render timechart
content.title: Event volume over time

content.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| mv-apply Tag = Tags on (
    where tostring(Tag.category) == "input_required"
    | summarize InputRequiredTags = make_set(tostring(Tag.display_name))
  )
| where array_length(InputRequiredTags) > 0
| project TimeGenerated, Platform, Name, Developer, Url, Risk, ChangeType, InputRequiredTags = strcat_array(InputRequiredTags, ", "), ResultUuid, AppId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Results pending client input (tag category input_required)

content.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tostring(Risk.category) in ("highest", "high")
| project TimeGenerated, Platform, Name, Developer, Url, Risk, ChangeType, ResultUuid, AppId, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: High / highest risk results

content.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, Platform, Name, AppId, Developer, Url, Description, CountryCodes, Risk, ChangeType, CloudEventType, Tags, ResultUuid, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Latest results
